ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: pairwise_cdf_margin_advantage_loss
ir.intuition: Shift from rank-margin losses to a probabilistic CDF-based loss by modeling the margin as a logistic random variable and computing the probability that the winning log-probability exceeds the losing one by a margin adjusted by advantage_gap. This paradigm treats the margin as a stochastic variable with a logistic CDF link function, changing the paradigm_family to pairwise_cdf and the link_family to logistic_cdf. Aggregation uses a weighted geometric mean (product of probabilities), enforcing a probabilistic interpretation rather than margin ranking. This approach encourages probabilistic calibration of margin differences relative to advantages.
ir.pseudocode:
margin = log_prob_w - log_prob_l - beta * advantage_gap
prob_win = sigmoid(alpha * margin)
weighted_log_prob = weight * log(prob_win + eps)
loss = -sum(weighted_log_prob)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    adv = batch['advantage_gap']
    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(adv))
    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    beta = float(extra.get('beta', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('beta', 0.5)))
    eps = 1e-12

    margin = ops.sub(ops.sub(lpw, lpl), ops.mul(beta, adv))
    scaled_margin = ops.mul(alpha, margin)
    prob_win = ops.sigmoid(scaled_margin)
    safe_prob = ops.add(prob_win, eps)
    log_prob = ops.log(safe_prob)
    weighted_log_prob = ops.mul(weight, log_prob)
    loss = ops.neg(ops.sum(weighted_log_prob))
    return loss
